operations.title: List add-ons
operations.description: List the governed add-ons for the current StackKit.

operations.title: Bind public addresses
operations.description: Bind an allocated prefix or install zone into canonical public routes and persist the validated StackSpec.

operations.title: Plan public addresses
operations.description: Emit the account-free, secret-free public address registration plan for the current StackSpec.

operations.title: Apply Advanced change set
operations.description: Checkpoint, apply and verify one exact Owner-signed Terramate change set with automatic verified rollback.

operations.title: Create Advanced change set
operations.description: Create a content-addressed Owner-signed Terramate change set from an offline capability and a candidate StackSpec.

operations.title: Run restore drill
operations.description: Stage and verify a restore of a backup anchor without activation, gated by an offline Advanced capability.

operations.title: Run coordinated rollback
operations.description: Roll every local Terramate stack back to one verified executor-state checkpoint in reverse run order, gated by an offline Advanced capability.

operations.title: Import Advanced trust
operations.description: Import an exact pinned Advanced issuer trust bundle into local Owner trust.

operations.title: Inspect Advanced trust
operations.description: Inspect the verified local Advanced issuer trust.

operations.title: Application compatibility
operations.description: Show the governed application and delivery-adapter support matrix.

operations.title: Apply
operations.description: Apply the exact persisted plan after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup
operations.description: Create a local owner-custodied backup snapshot.

operations.title: Configure backup repository
operations.description: Configure the CUE-governed local Kopia repository from the generated backup policy.

operations.title: Emergency export
operations.description: Export local data as a portable archive encrypted to age recipient public keys into a new directory.

operations.title: Emergency restore
operations.description: Decrypt and verify a portable emergency archive into a new staging directory without activating it.

operations.title: Activate restore
operations.description: Activate one verified staged restore into the live volumes behind an automatic safety snapshot.

operations.title: Recover restore
operations.description: Roll back an interrupted restore activation or finish its committed result.

operations.title: Disable backup schedule
operations.description: Revoke the local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Enable backup schedule
operations.description: Enable the CUE-governed local backup timer after explicit local Owner approval.

operations.title: Backup schedule status
operations.description: Read the local backup timer and signed schedule authorization without changing either.

operations.title: Backup status
operations.description: Read repository readiness, authenticated receipt history, current snapshot availability and declared recovery objectives.

operations.title: Backup target status
operations.description: Verify local backup target custody without contacting S3; returns opaque references only.

operations.title: List break-glass bundles
operations.description: List the encrypted break-glass bundles on this host.

operations.title: Show break-glass bundle
operations.description: Return the path of one node's still-encrypted break-glass bundle.

operations.title: Compatibility diagnostics
operations.description: Show published OS support evidence and run non-destructive local container-host diagnostics.

operations.title: Drift
operations.description: Observe desired-versus-applied standalone state drift.

operations.title: Reconcile drift
operations.description: Checkpoint, then generate, apply and verify through the governed local lifecycle with automatic verified rollback.

operations.title: Adopt Federation binding
operations.description: Validate, Owner-sign and atomically adopt an external Federation-link binding.

operations.title: Import Federation binding
operations.description: Admit an Owner-signed opaque Federation binding into local Inventory.

operations.title: Bind Federation control receiver
operations.description: Admit exact public Home authority and local receiver custody, replacing the previous receiver authority.

operations.title: Send Federation control action
operations.description: Send one Home-signed action to the selected Cloud node over an exact Home-initiated mTLS connection.

operations.title: Sign Federation control action
operations.description: Sign one exact short-lived plan or verify action with current Home custody.

operations.title: Withdraw Federation control receiver
operations.description: Persistently withdraw receiver authority, including existing TLS sessions.

operations.title: Bind Federation link
operations.description: Adopt external WireGuard handles into local Owner custody.

operations.title: Stop Federation link
operations.description: Stop the adopted Federation interface without deleting the external fabric.

operations.title: Admit game player
operations.description: Admit one player on a StackKits allow-list game server and read the game's allow list back.

operations.title: List game servers
operations.description: List the owner's game servers on the installed Game workload with state and port.

operations.title: Game server power
operations.description: Start, stop or restart one game server and wait for the observed state.

operations.title: Generate
operations.description: Generate rollout artifacts from the exact persisted ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Attach host conformance
operations.description: Attach exact host binding and conformance evidence to Inventory before plan generation.

operations.title: Host conformance receipt
operations.description: Produce a provider-neutral host conformance receipt, on stdout or as a workspace file.

operations.title: Host environment
operations.description: Observe whether this host looks like a home network or a public server.

operations.title: Host preflight
operations.description: Check whether this host can run the selected StackKit.

operations.title: Prepare Cloud host
operations.description: Provision the Cloud Kit execution-channel account, its privileges and workspace-custodied SSH key before apply.

operations.title: Remediate host
operations.description: Show the reversible fixes for host preflight findings, or carry out one named fix or every unattended reversible fix.

operations.title: Apply identity projection
operations.description: Apply one previously approved identity projection to local PocketID.

operations.title: Approve identity projection
operations.description: Create the local Owner-signed approval of one projection without changing PocketID.

operations.title: Inspect identity projection
operations.description: Verify one signed, credential-free identity projection without mutation.

operations.title: Unlink identity projection
operations.description: Detach optional identity sync without deleting any local identity.

operations.title: Enroll workload peer
operations.description: Issue and admit a workload peer for one installed Home publication; returns only public certificate documents.

operations.title: Install workload peer
operations.description: Install a Home-issued workload certificate using an independently verified Home root.

operations.title: Probe workload peer
operations.description: Request the workload origin through an existing loopback Federation socket.

operations.title: Request workload peer
operations.description: Create or reuse a locally held workload key and return only its public CSR.

operations.title: Revoke workload peer
operations.description: Withdraw a workload peer's current Home admission.

operations.title: Init
operations.description: Materialize a native StackSpec from the embedded CUE authoring contract.

operations.title: List releases
operations.description: List published StackKits releases from the public release index.

operations.title: Logs
operations.description: List local structured rollout logs.

operations.title: Read logs
operations.description: Read one structured rollout log page, the newest by default.

operations.title: Migrate StackSpec v1
operations.description: Classify a StackSpec v1, emit its migration report and optionally write the completed canonical StackSpec v2 to a new path.

operations.title: Lint modules
operations.description: Lint local module CUE for pin, health, security, access and placement hygiene.

operations.title: Scaffold module
operations.description: Render module artifacts deterministically from module_facts.json.

operations.title: Collect retired output transaction
operations.description: Inspect, or explicitly garbage-collect, one retired Architecture v2 output-transaction tombstone.

operations.title: Plan
operations.description: Inspect the persisted ResolvedPlan and generated artifact closure.

operations.title: Prepare check
operations.description: Run the read-only native host preflight that Apply uses on this host.

operations.title: Registry info
operations.description: Summarize the embedded StackKits registry snapshot.

operations.title: Remove
operations.description: Remove one governed workload from its exact applied ResolvedPlan after local Owner approval.

operations.title: Resolve
operations.description: Resolve StackSpec and observed Inventory into the canonical ResolvedPlan.

operations.title: Restore
operations.description: Verify and restore one signed snapshot into isolated staging.

operations.title: Abandon restore
operations.description: Close one pending or staged restore journal with explicit local Owner approval without touching repository or live volumes.

operations.title: Materialize secret custody
operations.description: Establish or reuse owner-bound local custody for every secret the current StackSpec declares; never returns values.

operations.title: Service logs
operations.description: Read bounded, redacted logs of one managed service.

operations.title: Restart service
operations.description: Restart one managed service declared by the active plan.

operations.title: Start service
operations.description: Start one managed service declared by the active plan.

operations.title: Stop service
operations.description: Stop one managed, non-critical service declared by the active plan.

operations.title: Set up application
operations.description: Set up and verify a Plan-declared app-local owner account on the existing application.

operations.title: Status
operations.description: Read the current standalone StackKits lifecycle status.

operations.title: Export support evidence
operations.description: Export one redacted local rollout log and its receipts to a new local file.

operations.title: Upgrade
operations.description: Resolve, verify, checkpoint, install, apply, and verify a StackKits release.

operations.title: List users
operations.description: List household users in local PocketID.

operations.title: Owner activation status
operations.description: Read the owner passkey activation status without its activation URL.

operations.title: Remove user
operations.description: Remove one household user from local PocketID; owner and admin identities are refused.

operations.title: Validate
operations.description: Validate desired StackSpec intent without mutating lifecycle state.

operations.title: Verify
operations.description: Verify desired, planned, applied, and observed local state.
